deploy-bot: Deploy v2026.03.18-rc3 -> prod/gateway finished. Canary at 10%. Post-deploy smoke run: 3/12 checks failing (primarily 409/429 on /api/generate). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/deploy/1796543210 :warning:
lauren: Noticed p95 shot up on gateway from ~120ms to ~420ms; 429 rate ~0.9% on canary nodes (eu-west-1). Sample traces attached in thread below.
ishan: On it. Pulling logs now. Can we pause the staggered rollout? Recommend hold + pin to previous variant until we triage.
emily: I see a correlated spike in batcher queue length and KV cache miss ratio around the same timestamps. Could be batching window interacting poorly with prefix cache misses.
ryan: Agreed hold. I'll add a temporary routing rule to pin traffic for gateway routes to v2026.03.17 for control plane and prod endpoints. Will also add a note to the release notes.
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10% by @ryan. Rollout hold enforced; automated rollback not triggered yet. Notifying SRE and product owners.
sre-oncall: Running synthetic probe against canary pool now (steady 250rps for 5m). Host-level metrics show CPU fine, but tail latencies up and connection queue length increased. Collecting tcpdump + logs.
lauren: Pasted a small sample of failing request ids: req=Z7f3.., Z7f9.., Z80a.. — see logs: ```
[2026-03-18T15:03:12Z] GET /api/generate 429 lambda=gw-7 node=gw-canary-3 batchSz=64 cacheMiss=1
[2026-03-18T15:03:12Z] GET /api/generate 429 lambda=gw-9 node=gw-canary-5 batchSz=32 cacheMiss=0
```
ishan: I have a quick patch to tighten the batch window for gateway (20ms -> 10ms) and an additional KV warmup call on request start. Can canary that on a single shard (gw-canary-3) to see if 429s drop.
emily: +1 to canary the patch on a single shard. I'll re-run smoke suite after 5m of steady traffic. If p95/k error rates recover, we can unpin and continue rollout.
ryan: I've updated the console pinning policy and added a changelog entry: "Rollout paused: gateway canary produced elevated 429s/p95; reverted traffic to v2026.03.17 for affected routes while we triage batcher interaction." Will also flag on the public release notes draft.
deploy-bot: Patch deployment scheduled to canary shard gw-canary-3 in 2m. Canary rollback window 15m. If smoke passes, will coordinate gradual resume.
sre-oncall: Synthetic around canary shard starting now. Sending alert if 429 > 0.2% for 3 consecutive minutes.
lauren: Thanks all — saving logs and request ids to the incident bucket: gs://redwood-incidents/1796543210/gateway-429s.log
ishan: If canary patch looks good I'll propose a follow-up hotfix release and a short postmortem note in release notes (root cause hypothesis: batch window + KV miss amplification).
emily: I'll prepare the quick rollback playbook steps and add the QA checklist for canary patch.
ryan: Hold remains for now. Next status update in ~25m or earlier if we see a pass/fail on the canary patch. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
